svg.desc: TLS WebSocket round trips/s. Orange: Scrapanium Bend; purple: matched curl_cffi Python. Bars are medians; whiskers span every run. python peer, 30 bytes, 1 connections: 19,608 versus 15,800; go peer, 30 bytes, 1 connections: 22,124 versus 18,581; go peer, 1024 bytes, 1 connections: 20,833 versus 20,206; go peer, 65536 bytes, 1 connections: 5,769 versus 4,445; go peer, 30 bytes, 4 connections: 38,685 versus 31,078; go peer, 1024 bytes, 4 connections: 38,647 versus 28,979; go peer, 65536 bytes, 4 connections: 15,385 versus 10,382. 7 shuffled repeats. Both clients check every byte and opcode inside timing. Verified loopback TLS, matched backend, Chrome 146. Multiple connections use independent client processes. Startup, upgrade, warmup and close excluded. Source: benchmarks/results/websocket.json.
